Description:
# SM (Save Manager)

给 **Casualties Unknown** 加**无上限存档槽**的 BepInEx 5 插件。
Unlimited save slots for **Casualties Unknown** — a BepInEx 5 plugin.

[中文](#中文) · [English](#english) · [License](#license)

---

## 中文

### 简介

原版只有一个续关点 `save.sv`，而且**读档成功后就把文件删掉**。SM 把每次存档拍成独立快照：游戏里随时按 `F5` 存，设置菜单里多出一个「存档」分页可以挑任意一档读，档数没有上限，游戏外也能直接拖文件换档。界面全部用游戏原生 prefab 拼，和设置菜单其它页一个样。

### 功能

- **无上限存档槽**：每次存档一个独立文件夹，自动命名（`2026-11-22_1534_D1`）
- **游戏内随时存档**：`F5`，不用回主菜单
- **设置菜单第 6 个分页「存档」**：左侧操作栏 + 右侧可滚动存档列表，行/字体/边框/音效都是游戏原生的
- **游戏内直接读档**：解除暂停 → 回主菜单 → 铺档 → 继续，回到该层开头
- **沙盒档 / 实机档双向隔离**：沙盒里只看得到沙盒档，反之亦然，跨模式读取会被拒绝
- **联机兼容**：把 [CasualtiesTogether](https://github.com/creaturefeaturelarry/casualties-together) 的 `mp_save\`（每个玩家的 `STEAM_<id>\save.sv`、`mp_rules.json`）整目录收进槽里
- **覆盖前自动留上一档**，可一键回滚
- **所有开关都能在游戏里改**（存档页 →「存档选项与设置 ▸」独立子页），改完立即写盘，下次启动保持
- **控制台命令**，方便脚本化

### 安装

需要 **BepInEx 5.4.23.x**（`netstandard2.1`）。

- **Gale / Thunderstore**：在模组列表里搜 `SM` 或 `SaveManager` 直接装（社区：Casualties: Unknown）
- **手动**：

```
<游戏目录>\BepInEx\plugins\SaveManager\SaveManager.dll
```

启动后 `BepInEx\LogOutput.log` 里应能看到 `设置页已注册「存档」分页`。

### 使用

| 键 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| `F5` | 存档到新槽（自动命名） |
| `F8` | 打开设置 →「存档」分页（游戏内会先自动暂停） |
| `F9` | 读最近一档（按当前模式取） |

也可以走原生路径：`Esc` 暂停 → 设置 → 点「存档」。

存档页布局：

```
┌──────────────┬──────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ ＋ 新建存档   │ 已选：2026-11-22_1534_D1                 │
│ 读取最近一档  │ ┌ 新名字 ──────────────────────────────┐ │
│ 打开文件夹    │ └──────────────────────────────────────┘ │
│ 读取此档      │ 共 4 档（无上限，按时间倒序）             │
│ 回滚上一档    │ ▶ 2026-11-22_1621_D1  D1 · 0m28s · 4件 · 联机 │
│ 删除此档      │   2026-11-22_1610_D1  D1 · 1m22s · 0件 · 沙盒 │
│ 存档设置 ▸    │   …（右侧列表可滚轮/拖拽滚动）            │
└──────────────┴──────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

控制台命令：

```
cssave [名字]      存一个新槽（不写名字=自动命名）
cslots             列出所有槽
csload <槽名>      读这个槽（回主菜单流程）
csslots            打开设置里的「存档」分页
csdir              打开存档目录
csdel <槽名>       删除
csrename <旧> <新>  改名
csrollback <槽名>   回滚到该槽的 backup/
csexport <槽名>     把槽铺成游戏当前的 save.sv
```

### 存档放在哪

```
%USERPROFILE%\AppData\LocalLow\Orsoniks\CasualtiesUnknown\SaveSlots\
  <槽名>\
    meta.json     元数据（时间/层数/存活/角色/件数/模式/沙盒/作弊/玩家）
    save.sv       单人存档（原版格式，gzip + JSON）
    mp\           联机存档（存在时才有）
    backup\       覆盖同名槽之前的上一档
```

不进游戏换档：

1. 关掉游戏
2. `SaveSlots\<槽名>\save.sv` 覆盖到 `...\Orsoniks\CasualtiesUnknown\save.sv`
3. 联机档：`SaveSlots\<槽名>\mp\` 整个覆盖到 `...\CasualtiesUnknown\mp_save\`
4. 开游戏 → 主菜单点「继续」

### 配置

`BepInEx\config\suzuay.savemanager.cfg`（也能在游戏「存档设置」子页改，重启后保持）

| 键 | 默认 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `ExperimentalInGameLoad` | `true` | 游戏内直接读档 |
| `AutoSave.Enabled` / `Minutes` | `false` / `5` | 定时自动存档 |
| `MarkCheatedSave` | `false` | 存档标记 cheated（成就关闭到重启） |
| `SandboxNoCheatMark` | `true` | 沙盒里不标作弊 |
| `AllowInMultiplayer` | `true` | 联机时允许存读档 |
| `KeepLastBackup` | `true` | 覆盖同名槽前保留上一档 |
| `BypassTutorialGate` | `true` | 没做完基础教程也能读档 |
| `SlotRootOverride` | 空 | 自定义存档根目录 |
| `QuickSave` / `QuickLoad` / `Panel` | `F5` / `F9` / `F8` | 键位 |

### 已知限制

1. **读档回到当前层的开头**：原版 `save.sv` 只存身体/物品/世界数值，不含地图布局与玩家坐标，地图每层随机重新生成（原版 `saveandquit` 同样如此）
2. **深度 ≥ 9（WHERE WE MUST REACH 及之后）**：原版不许存档，本插件绕过控制台检查直接调 `SaveGame()`，但读回来是否正常未验证，别在终点层存
3. **联机**：只负责整目录搬运 `mp_save\`，多人局细节取决于 CasualtiesTogether 本身
4. **成就**：`MarkCheatedSave` 默认关；打开后按原版语义「成就关闭到重启」

### 兼容性

| 项 | 版本 |
|---|---|
| 游戏 | Casualties Unknown（Unity **2022.3.62f3**，Mono） |
| BepInEx | 5.4.23.x（`netstandard2.1`） |
| HarmonyX | 随 BepInEx 一起（`0Harmony.dll`） |
| 联机模组 | CasualtiesTogether（`mp_save\` 格式） |

### 构建

```powershell
git clone https://github.com/SuzuAy/SaveManager
cd SaveManager
Copy-Item local.props.example local.props   # 填自己的游戏路径
dotnet build SaveManager.csproj -c Release
```

`local.props` 填两个路径：`GameRoot`（游戏根目录，含 `CasualtiesUnknown_Data\Managed`）、`GaleProfileBepInEx`（BepInEx 目录，含 `core\` 与 `plugins\`）。编完自动把 DLL 拷到 `plugins\SaveManager\`。

也可以直接命令行覆盖：

```powershell
dotnet build -c Release -p:GameRoot="D:\Games\Casualties Unknown" -p:GaleProfileBepInEx="D:\Games\Casualties Unknown\BepInEx"
```

## English

### What it is

Vanilla *Casualties Unknown* keeps a single resume point (`save.sv`) and **deletes it once you load it**. SM snapshots every save into its own folder: press `F5` anytime, open the new **Save** tab in the settings menu to load any slot — unlimited slots — and you can swap files on disk while the game is closed. The UI is built from the game's own prefabs, so it matches the rest of the settings menu.

### Features

- **Unlimited slots**, auto-named (`2026-11-22_1534_D1`)
- **Save anytime in-game** with `F5`
- **Native "Save" tab** (6th settings page): left action column + scrollable slot list
- **In-game load**: unpause → main menu → restore files → continue (back to the start of the current layer)
- **Sandbox / normal saves are isolated** from each other; cross-loading is refused
- **Multiplayer aware**: captures the whole `mp_save\` folder used by [CasualtiesTogether](https://github.com/creaturefeaturelarry/casualties-together) (per-player `STEAM_<id>\save.sv`, `mp_rules.json`)
- **Keeps the previous version** of a slot before overwriting; one-click rollback
- **All options editable in-game** (Save → "Save options ▸" sub-page) and persisted to the config
- **Console commands** for scripting

### Install

Requires **BepInEx 5.4.23.x** (`netstandard2.1`).

- **Gale / Thunderstore**: search `SM` or `SaveManager` (community: Casualties: Unknown)
- **Manual**: drop the DLL at `<GameDir>\BepInEx\plugins\SaveManager\SaveManager.dll`

### Keys

`F5` save · `F8` open the Save tab · `F9` load the most recent slot of the current mode

```
cssave [name]   cslots   csload <slot>   csslots   csdir
csdel <slot>    csrename <old> <new>    csrollback <slot>    csexport <slot>
```

### Save location

```
%USERPROFILE%\AppData\LocalLow\Orsoniks\CasualtiesUnknown\SaveSlots\<slot>\
    meta.json   save.sv   mp\   backup\
```

To swap a slot outside the game: copy `<slot>\save.sv` over `...\CasualtiesUnknown\save.sv` (and `<slot>\mp\` over `...\CasualtiesUnknown\mp_save\` for multiplayer saves), then launch the game and press Continue.

### Known limitations

1. Loading returns you to the **beginning of the current layer** — vanilla saves contain no map layout or player position
2. Depth ≥ 9 layers cannot be saved in vanilla; this mod bypasses that check but loading such a save is untested
3. Multiplayer handling is limited to copying `mp_save\`; the rest is up to CasualtiesTogether
4. `MarkCheatedSave` is off by default; enabling it disables achievements until restart

Name: CasualtyPsychology
Summary: Reworks mental health in Casualties Unknown with 6 mood pillars, randomized traits, panic attacks, directional head trauma, sleep events, and contextual dialogue.
Description:
![Casualty Psychology](https://files.catbox.moe/80k3s1.png) **v0.8.3** > **Casualty Psychology** reworks how mental health works in Cas:U. Fear, trauma, bad injuries, pitch darkness, and being alone all feed into how your Sawian holds together down in the caves. It's up to you how good their day is going to be. ![divider](https://files.catbox.moe/5ep62r.png)
## Requirements & Install - **Casualties Unknown** (Full release. For Demo, use CASPSY 0.7.4) - **[BepInEx 5](https://github.com/BepInEx/BepInEx/releases/tag/v5.4.23.5)** (x64) - **[CUCoreLib](https://www.nexusmods.com/scavprototype/mods/341)** Install with a Thunderstore mod manager (r2modman / Gale), or manually: 1. Install **BepInEx 5** in your game folder if you don't have it yet. 2. Drop `CUCoreLib.dll` and `CasualtyPsychology.dll` into `BepInEx/plugins/`. 3. Copy `Assets/CasualtyPsychology` into `BepInEx/plugins/Assets/CasualtyPsychology/`. 4. Boot the game once to generate the config. You can change most settings in-game under **Options** (**Psychology** button).
![divider](https://files.catbox.moe/5ep62r.png)
## What It Does ### ![Mood](https://files.catbox.moe/055nq9.png) Mood, Traits & Trauma Instead of one happiness bar, mood is split across six stats (**Valence**, **Arousal**, **Agency**, **Predictability**, **Social**, and **Goal Satisfaction**). Each run also rolls up to 3 starting traits out of 16, from resilience and fatalism to transhumanism. Or none. You, and your expie will remember the bad. Getting hit by bear traps, mines, or turrets leaves phobias and trauma imprinted in the mind, that can set off auditory flashbacks later during panic attacks. Survive around a hazard without getting hurt and your Sawian slowly gets used to it, and maybe a little confident. ### ![Panic](https://files.catbox.moe/qcacxe.png) Panic, Somatics & Head Trauma - **Adrenaline & Pain Storms**: Heavy hits numb the pain for a few seconds so you have time to bandage up before it all hits at once, a grace period if you will. - **Panic Attacks**: High stress and bad mood ramp up from simple tremors into food refusal, weapon sway, movement slowdown, blocked actions, vomiting, hallucinations, etcetera. - **Head Injuries**: Hits track where the skull took damage (**Brow**, **Temples**, **Crown**, **Occiput**). Depending on the zone, you can end up with slurred speech, garbled dialogue, scrambled labels, lobotomies, or other fun effects apart from the vanilla ones. Healing with **Braingrow** also conditions your Sawian differently if you do it mid-fight versus somewhere safe. - **Despair & Crises**: It may be worth keeping a move on to avoid certain impulses your sawian may have. Leave them at rock bottom for long enough and the consequences are dire. It is your responsibility to upkeep your sawian and maintaining them happy, throughout the rocky roads of the caves. ### ![Sleep](https://files.catbox.moe/tq02nt.png) Sleep & Darkness Where you rest actually matters. Pods, lit campfires, and teammates keep sleep calm. Passing out or sleeping in pitch darkness next to corpses or traps risks **nightmares** and **sleep paralysis** (freezing you in place for up to 40 seconds unless something snaps you out of it). Light sources, sleeping pills, or a plushie stop paralysis. ### ![Dossier](https://files.catbox.moe/bmz4m9.png) Dossier & Dialogue - **Clinical Intake Dossier**: An e-ink tablet you start with in the pod. Open it to check your rolled traits, conditions, stress tendencies, head notes, and memory log. - **Dialogue & Unchipped**: Over a thousand lines split across **Expie**, **Milky**, and **Dune** for wounds, darkness, amputations, haggling, and recovery. With some indicators for those that like the unchipped challenge. ### ![Items](https://files.catbox.moe/qlzm1m.png) Items & Survival Changes - **Mindclean**: Clears 30 trauma with some dizziness and nausea, with a 70/30 gamble on wiping bad memories vs good ones. Do YOU wanna take the gamble? - **Plushies & Prosthetics**: Plushies ground panic warnings and prevent sleep paralysis. Having steel or PEO prosthetics packed makes cutting a limb off a lot less rough (especially with **Transhumanism**). - **Diet, Crystals & Last Stand**: Eating the same food repeatedly gives diminishing returns, Soothing Crystal Shards burn faster when depressed, and Last Stand checks your current agency, resilience, plushies, and teammates instead of an old happiness snapshot, making it more difficult to roll at rock bottom. - **Among the many, many changes that the mod brings** If you want all the exact numbers, trait tables, and full command list, check `GUIDE.md` inside the zip.
![divider](https://files.catbox.moe/5ep62r.png)
## Commands, Config & Compatibility
Console Commands Hit `~` to open the console and use `psych` (full syntax and MP selectors like `@a` are in `GUIDE.md`, this is just simple commands): - `psych status` - Shows pillars, traits, trauma, panic, and crisis stage. - `psych reset` / `heal` - Clears trauma and phobias, stops panic, and resets pillars. - `psych pillar add v20 a-10` - Views or edits pillars. - `psych trait` - Lists, adds, removes, or rerolls traits. - `psych head ` - Tests directional brain damage. - `psych panic <1|2|3|stop>` - Starts or stops a panic attack. - `psych nightmare now` / `psych paralysis now` - Triggers sleep events. - `psych dossier` - Spawns an intake dossier.
Config & Menu Most options can be changed live from the in-game **Psychology** menu (next to the game logo) or in `BepInEx/config/CasualtyPsychology.cfg`. You can adjust decay rates, trauma multipliers, dialogue frequency, screen effects, or toggle panic, flashbacks, sleep paralysis, mindwipe revamp, and terminal suicide on or off.
Multiplayer & Compatibility - **Multiplayer**: Works with **Krokosha Casualties MP**. Host trait and condition rules sync for the session without overwriting your own preset, and everyone gets their own dossier, traits, and conditions. Both host and clients need the mod (and on the same version). - **Euphoric**: Works well alongside it. - **Gunsaw Genetics**: Works, though custom species balance can be a bit hit or miss, still figuring it out. - **Overhauls**: No official ports yet. Stacking big health overhauls can cause fast trauma spirals, so lower the trauma multipliers in config if it gets too rough. - **Addon dialogue**: Built-in lines/support for *Casualties: Under the Influence* (comradefoxx), *Collars: Unknown* (gouxi), and *Substances Expanded* (Shiri).
![divider](https://files.catbox.moe/5ep62r.png)

![alt text](https://i.postimg.cc/jSRfJShm/img-2026-11-22-03-46-22.png)
## What Is CUCoreLib?

CUCoreLib is an **exhaustive shared modding library and documentation project** for Casualties: Unknown, built for both **beginners** and **veteran mod authors**.

Instead of every mod reinventing the same systems over and over, CUCoreLib provides a common foundation alongside documentation.

**We have:**

- A human-written shared framework for building mods faster
- A safer compatibility layer for future modding work and multi-mod compatibility
- A very well documented API surface with examples and videos ([cucorelib.jimmyking.dev](https://cucorelib.jimmyking.dev))
- A very active open-source project intended to grow with community feedback and contributions
- A ton of emphasis on backwards compatibility (A mod made for v0.1 of CUCoreLib still works now!)

## What Does It Provide?

**Core library features**

- Helper functions and shared utility systems
- Publicized access to useful private game data
- Mod-compatible patch hooks, meant for use across multiples of mods
- Documentation through an external webapp with examples, references, and videos
- Streamling of modding with hot reloading and helper functions in lieu of harmony patches.
- Automatic support and update compatibility for multiplayer, QoL, and other popular mods

**In-game modular API support**

- Custom items, liquids, containers, weapons, crafting materials, equipment, guns, and more
- Custom world entities, tiles, traps, liquids, enemies, drop tables, and interactables
- Asset loading, spritesheet support, audio loading, and general parsing.
- Moodles and custom body and limb status effects
- Crafting and recipes
- Automatic locale and translation support
- Settings menu, console, world setting support
- Compatible saving and persistent mod data
- Multiplayer API and many, many helpers
- Custom minigame and animation support via assetbundle loading
- XML documentation alongside normal documentation
- General utility systems for mod authors (CUCoreUtils)

**Automatic mod compatibility**

- Multiplayer item, liquid, lootpool, tile, recipe, entity sync without needing code.
- Basic multiplayer sync, even without clients needing your mod! (If they have CUCoreLib)
- Integration with other mods, such as QoL, FullSave, What Mod Is This From, Wiki Search, CPU Optimization, Custom Structures, etc..
- CUCoreLib wrappers that will automatically update with other mod updates, to allow mods to work with one another. 

## Why Use It?

A lot of mods need the same basic foundation:

- Loading custom assets, sounds, etc..
- Registering items, liquids, recipes, and world content..
- Saving mod data safely..
- Patching game systems without exploding on updates..
- Staying compatible with other mods
- Handling multiplayer-related integration

Without a shared library, every mod author ends up building their own version of the same systems. That makes mods harder to maintain, harder to update, more likely to conflict, and more annoying to extend later.

*CUCoreLib aims to become a common framework the modding scene can build on together.*


---

## Documentation

![Documentation webapp](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/c836ede6-7aa3-4676-8051-37560beaa419)

The documentation site is designed to help both new and experienced modders get productive quickly.

- Click to [open the live documentation website](https://cucorelib.jimmyking.dev/docs/welcome/)
- Browse setup steps, examples, and API references
- Find examples on the right pane

![Documentation examples](https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/8391/images/341/341-1781948099-1490581757.png)

*(and maybe help contribute to the documentation yourself ;))*

**Useful links**

- [Setup / Quick Start](https://cucorelib.jimmyking.dev/docs/setup/)
- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/jimmyking9999999/CUCoreLib)
- [Releases / Downloads](https://github.com/jimmyking9999999/CUCoreLib/releases)
- [Youtube Beginner's Guide](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=agmxPgXdQtI)

---

## Installation / Quick Setup

**Players:** install CUCoreLib with thunderstore's mod manager, and it'll be pulled in automatically by any mod that depends on it.

Alternatively, you can install it here, and move to your BepInEx `/plugins` folder. 

**Mod developers:**

1. Download the latest release from [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/jimmyking9999999/CUCoreLib/releases) (or nightly, if you're feeling adventurous), or grab it from here.
2. Place **CUCoreLib.dll** into your BepInEx plugins folder.

```
C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Casualties Unknown\BepInEx\plugins
```

3. Add the DLL as a reference in your Visual Studio project.
4. Also add the game's own **Assembly-CSharp.dll** as a reference.
5. Start building your own mod.

```xml
<Reference Include="CUCoreLib">
  <HintPath>..\PATH\TO\YOUR\CUCoreLib.dll</HintPath>
</Reference>
```

**Want the full guide?** See the documentation setup page here: [https://cucorelib.jimmyking.dev/docs/setup/](https://cucorelib.jimmyking.dev/docs/setup/)

---

## Contributing


**This library is fully open source and open to pull requests!**

![Contributing](https://i.postimg.cc/zvm4Jq3q/contributing.png)

Contributions are very welcome, provided you do not fully use AI (and properly test!)

- Bug fixes are welcome
- API improvements are also welcome!
- Compatibility improvements are very welcome
- Documentation improvements are very very welcome

For contribution guidelines and source, see: [https://github.com/jimmyking9999999/CUCoreLib](https://github.com/jimmyking9999999/CUCoreLib)

---

## Discord / Support

![Discord](https://i.postimg.cc/TYvXxJWV/discord.png)

Have a question? Suggestion? Bug report but you're too shy to make an issue on GitHub? Ask us in the [Discord](https://discord.gg/ehCptz9pwU) channel!

### Happy modding!

# Custom Structures

![Custom Structures](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/e5339102-374f-4d4d-904d-f3b21a762686)

A mod that adds >1300 user-created custom structures!

  [![Total Downloads](https://img.shields.io/github/downloads/jimmyking9999999/CU-Custom-Structures/total?color=blue&logo=github)](https://github.com/jimmyking9999999/CU-Custom-Structures/releases)
  [![Nexus Downloads](https://img.shields.io/endpoint?url=https%3A%2F%2Fraw.githubusercontent.com%2Fjimmyking9999999%2FMetadata-generator%2Fmain%2Fbadges%2Fcustom-structures.json)](https://www.nexusmods.com/scavprototype/mods/9)
  
  
---

## A World Built From Everyone

![](https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/8391/images/9/9-1789382528-1655297033.png)
![](https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/8391/images/9/9-1789382718-2034293696.png)

Custom Structures lets you create and use custom structures made from other people!

Design structures in the browser, export them, and drop them directly into your game.

[**More than 1307 structures**](https://cu-custom-structures.jimmyking.dev/structures.html) are already available to discover and use. Woah.

![](https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/8391/images/9/9-1789382791-727552308.png)
![](https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/8391/images/9/9-1789383144-97659329.png)

---

## What's Included?

### Custom Structures In-game

Add fresh new structures filled with dangers and loot to your runs, made from the community!
Browse structures with the online or in-game structure browser.

### Online Structure Editor and Browser

Build and edit structures visually with the browser-based editor, and share it with the world!
Create with custom properties for every tile, liquid, item, and entity.

---

##  Structure Editor

![](https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/8391/images/9/9-1789383609-1787627978.png)

Create, edit, preview, and export your own structures in the online editor!

### [Open The Editor Here! ->](https://cu-structure-editor.web.app)

### Editor Controls

The editor follows the control scheme of Aseprite, and is heavily inspired by said program ^^

- **Middle mouse:** Pick blocks or pan
- **Space:** Pan camera
- **S:** Select tool
- **B:** Brush tool
- **Ctrl + C / Ctrl + V:** Copy and paste
- **Ctrl + Z / Ctrl + Y:** Undo and redo

Otherwise, use the given tools in the application! There's little you can't hover on for help

![](https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/8391/images/9/9-1789384076-1921108822.png)
![](https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/8391/images/9/9-1789384046-768233069.png)
![](https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/8391/images/9/9-1789383733-958829607.png)

---

## Downloading Community Structures

1. Visit the [Structures Library](https://cu-structure-editor.web.app/structures.html)
2. Download any structures you want.
3. Move them into the `BepInEx/plugins/Structures` folder (with a mod manager, this is inside your profile folder)
4. Restart the game or run `reloadstructures` via the console

Alternatively, open the in-game structure browser in the main menu background and download directly into the game!

![](https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/8391/images/9/9-1789384352-1789266836.png)

---

## Console Commands

| Command | Description |
|---|---|
| `structure {id}` | Spawn a custom structure |
| `locatestructure {id}` | Locate a custom structure |
| `reloadstructures` | Reload all structure files |

---

## Installation

You're able to (and recommended to) install this with a mod manager. Thanks, Thunderstore!

For a manual install, extract the mod into `BepInEx/plugins`, alongside [CUCoreLib](https://thunderstore.io/c/casualties-unknown/p/Jimmyking/CUCoreLib/):

```
Casualties Unknown/
└── BepInEx/
    └── plugins/
        ├── CUCoreLib.dll
        ├── CustomStructures.dll
        └── Structures/
            └── YourStructure.txt
```

---
Enjoy your structures!

Description:
# New Descents

*Here be dragons~*

![New Descents](https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/8391/images/662/662-1788911033-111451785.png)

A vast content mod, with new layers to explore and new mechanics to conquer.

---

## Beyond the familiar depths...

![](https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/8391/images/662/662-1788911413-1911447711.png)
![](https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/8391/images/662/662-1788911424-2128342172.png)
![](https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/8391/images/662/662-1788911431-203128131.png)

...Two new layers await. The Toxic Caverns (layer 6) bring luminous growth, strange crystals, and corrosive pools. While deeper still, the living halls of Viscerae (layer 7) pulse with a heartbeat you can feel in your bones.

**New Descents** brings new environments to explore, materials to scavenge, supplies to craft, and new traps and enemies. This mod has over 270 combined images, assets, sound effects, shaders, and multiple hours of post-game content.

![](https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/8391/images/662/662-1788911465-518941410.png)
![](https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/8391/images/662/662-1788911468-1911677362.png)
![](https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/8391/images/662/662-1788911474-1354311732.png)

---

## Layer 6 - Toxic Caverns

![Toxic Caverns](https://i.postimg.cc/DzM0gy93/toxiccaverns.png)

### A new ecosystem to explore

Descend into a unique procedurally generated layer filled with varied rock formations, slime deposits, ores, crystals, and custom-made structures.

![](https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/8391/images/662/662-1788912101-128866782.png)

### An unfamiliar ecosystem

Light your way with hanging Lumivines, extract nectar from Toxic Pink Blooms, and power your devices with living Pulse Crystal Nodes.

![](https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/8391/images/662/662-1788912205-1034050215.png)

### Your demise, waiting at every corner

Toxic acid, empowered enemies, and new traps do not take your intrusion very kindly. Fight, or follow the myriad of those before you.

![](https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/8391/images/662/662-1788912226-986594344.png)

<details>
<summary>Spoiler: Layer 6 items with unique effects</summary>

**Bioluminescent Gel**
Apply it to yourself and become a walking light source, for 15 minutes. Are we sure this isn't radioactive?

![](https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/8391/images/662/662-1792565367-301578963.png)

**Pulse Core**
Power electronic equipment with a biological battery. 2x as efficient as a medium battery, and can slot into any piece of equipment.
It may be unstable, and worth a close watch...

**Toxic Poultice**
Become one with the land with a cold, slimy helping of local biology.

**Bug Repellent Mush**
Keep cave ticks far away, and traders too...

**Pulse Lantern**
What better way to harness the power of the toxic alien crystal than putting it into a container and having it light your way? A handheld lantern with a bright green glow with 120 minute battery life.

**Wrapvine Bandage**
A more refined tonguewrap. Excellent for stopping external bleeding. Heals skin, muscle, pain, bone fractures, and dislocations all at once.

**Spore Filter**
A mesh film that lets air through. And aerosols, not so much. A reusable crafting component. Use it to filter toxic acid or lumalgae into clean water.

![](https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/8391/images/662/662-1792565418-519646897.png)

**Endomorphic Jelly**
...is it staring at you? No, it's staring at your items. Drag it onto a damaged item to restore 25% of its condition. The jelly is consumed in the process.
...this may have effects in the future...

</details>

![](https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/8391/images/662/662-1788911837-306599658.png)

*May your journey be filled with curses and blessings.*

---

## Layer 7 - Viscerae

![Viscerae](https://i.postimg.cc/rpPsJFvb/viscarae.png)

### A breathing, living layer

Past the Toxic Caverns, the walls turn to flesh. The layer pulses with a heartbeat, its residents living alongside it. Veins glow beneath the surface, and the air itself is thick with the mist of living tissue.

![](https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/8391/images/662/662-1792563326-670257772.png)

### Assimilation

Every hazard, every thing you break, every drop of blood you spill on its floors feeds it. The deeper you go, the more the layer claims you. Its entities grows stronger, your vision and hearing warps, and blocks start bleeding. At full assimilation... you will not be leaving.

![](https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/8391/images/662/662-1792563290-829316199.png)

### An ecosystem that hunts back

Climb bloodvines, dodge eyestalks that latch onto your limbs, run from the ceiling maws that reel you in, and learn to read the laser traps that scar and char the walls. New monsters, new traps, and new biological tools await.

![](https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/8391/images/662/662-1792563264-1712104344.png)

*This blood's the wrong color?!.*

<details>
<summary>Spoiler: Layer 7 items with unique effects</summary>

**Carmine Property**
All carmine equipment gains condition when you take damage, scaling with severity. At 1% condition, the worn piece damages you instead to maintain itself.

![](https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/8391/images/662/662-1792564277-492187710.png)

**Carmine Material Pouch**
- Capacity: 5u → 7u
- Max Weight / Item: 0.25u → 0.5u (fits browncap, fungus chunk, small mag/box of 12gauge/magazinebase/riflemag, large batteries, lightbulbs, etc.)
- Encumbrance reduction: 80%
- Weight: 0.75u → 0.9u
- Duration: 5 hours → 45 minutes

**Carmine Backpack**
- Capacity: 7.5u → 8u
- Insulation: 7% → 15%
- Protection: 0% → 22% (thorax, abdomen)
- Encumbrance reduction: 45% → 55%
- Duration: 1h30m → 40 minutes
- *Special: Items contained decay at 0.9× the normal rate*

**Carmine Handdrill**
Can be used to "cauterize" wounds. At the cost of massive condition, stops blood loss from a bleed wound for 5 minutes.
- Storage: 222ml (holds red/yellow/animal blood as condition)
- Uses: 700 (red blood) / 1050 (yellow blood) / 350 (animal blood)
- *Attacking enemies restores blood in the drill.*

**Bloodvine Climbing Cordage**
4 uses. Creates a bloodvine from 50% to 80% downward to the floor. Extended placement range, but can only be placed on the undersides of non-scaffolding/scrap blocks.

**Thorn Slinger**
A multi-caliber gun that accepts any ammunition type:
- **Pistol ammo:** Semi-auto, fires a 2-round burst per bullet
- **12-gauge:** Semi-auto, fires 10 pellets 0.04s apart
- **Rifle ammo:** Full-auto, each hit restores 0.05L blood if not at max

![](https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/8391/images/662/662-1792564392-2133699577.png)

**Hemostatic Assimilator**
Single use. Permanently increases immunity by 10% and natural blood & skin regeneration rate by 1.2×.

**Bloodgum**
On consumption (5-minute cooldown), grants *Blood Bubble* status for ~12 seconds, which fully blocks the first instance of external damage.
Can also be used on limbs for skin health and disinfection.

**Infinite Steak**
Regenerating foodstuff, fully restores over 30 minutes.
- +18 Saturation
- +7 Sickness (+15 if last eaten food was also infinite steak)
- +0.544 Weight
- +2 Mood
- -55% Condition

**Activated Pulse Core**
A self-recharging pulse core... surely nothing bad will happen..?

<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

Recharges infinitely. At 250% hidden overcharge, goes *boom*. Better use it ;)

</details>

**Vitreous Eye**
This unblinking eye can be used to restore a lost eye, at a very steep price...

**Hematite Weaver**
A mysterious intertwined piece of flesh and steel.
Infinitely generates and restores scrap metal, holding up to 3 max in its storage.

</details>

![](https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/8391/images/662/662-1792564516-2137758705.png)

*"...how far down is this battery again...?"*

---

## Before you descend!

- **BepInEx 5 and CUCoreLib are required.**

![](https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/8391/images/662/662-1788913218-1014110416.png)

- This mod has compatibility with most CUCoreLib-based mods, as well as [QoL: Unknown](https://www.nexusmods.com/scavprototype/mods/7?tab=bugs) and [Custom Structures](https://www.nexusmods.com/scavprototype/mods/9?tab=posts)
- Unsurprisingly, this mod does not work with any other mods that add new layers or alter saving (e.g. ReMiyamure's Layer Unlocker, FullSave, CU-SaveManager, RshLib)
- This mod is in a early alpha version! Please report any bugs! (with the `bug-report` command if possible)
- Feel free to go into the settings menu for a quickstart option to experience the new layers. It is intended to be completed after you have progressed through all prior layers and have appropriate equipment (even if said quickstart tries its best to give you a decent loadout/exp range)

---

### Questions? Want to help contribute? Want the testing versions? Join the [Discord](https://discord.gg/xRb7jMH3MF)!

Description:
# QoL: Unknown ![QoL: Unknown](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/96fe38ed-0df2-4a25-95f6-498e4627938f) [![Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/jimmyking9999999/QoL-Unknown?include_prereleases&label=release&color=orange&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/jimmyking9999999/QoL-Unknown/releases/latest) [![Downloads](https://img.shields.io/github/downloads/jimmyking9999999/QoL-Unknown/total?label=downloads&color=blue&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/jimmyking9999999/QoL-Unknown/releases) [![Nexus](https://img.shields.io/endpoint.svg?url=https%3A%2F%2Fraw.githubusercontent.com%2Fjimmyking9999999%2FMetadata-generator%2Fmain%2Fbadges%2Fqol-unknown.json)](https://www.nexusmods.com/scavprototype/mods/7) ![Game version](https://img.shields.io/badge/game%20version-v7.1.0-green) --- **QoL: Unknown** is an all-in-one quality-of-life mod for Casualties: Unknown. It adds accessibility, comfort, and convenience features without touching the core mechanics of the game. Every system is optional, and everything has its own toggle! This mod works alongside other public mods, including content mods built on CUCoreLib and the Together multiplayer mod. Below is a list of some of the added features of this mod: (click to expand!)
Saving & Seeded Runs - Mid-layer saves that retain world generation, traps, enemies, etc... - Seeded runs for consistent worlds. (This syncs worlds down to the same keycode and items from drop pods!) - Autosave every three minutes in the background while you are alive and standing - Loading restores your position, layer state, radline state, run settings and timers ![Saving](https://i.postimg.cc/QVZNXmY2/img-2026-10-14-05-50-04.png)
Inventory & Crafting - Quick-transfer for liquids and items via **Shift + Drag** - Inventory auto-sort, prioritizing saved slots at low total weight, and lowest weight otherwise - Scroll bars for containers that go offscreen - Quick item pickup using middle-mouse button, which quickly stash your item into containers or equip the item - Quick Stash picks up the item nearest your cursor and files it into a held or worn container, with a configurable keybind - An opened ground container can be emptied using its real world position and normal distance rules - A scrollable carousel once you have more than seven equipped items - Enhanced the crafting menu item preview, with component autocraft and multi-craft additions - Bulk crafting with an adjustable quantity selector - Improved recipe search, and drag an item onto the crafting menu to see every recipe that uses it - Recipe fixes for liquid containers and non-empty container ingredients ![Inventory & Crafting](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/3898e7f5-5c83-4aae-80cd-b4eab6437833)
Gameplay & World - 1-tile water no longer pushes the player, and water physics is more lenient - Layer modifiers are able to be adjusted individually (e.g., enabling only dried layers) - Difficulty sliders are no longer restricted, and can be set to above normal limits - Sound cannon indicator - Extra settings to retain several v6 behaviour traits - Individual entity density options. Description:
# UEI — Unknown Enough Items 1.2.10

Casualties: Unknown 的物品、液体与配方查询插件，界面支持简体中文和 English。

An item, liquid and recipe browser for Casualties: Unknown, with a Chinese and English UI.

中文说明在前，English version follows below.

## 中文

UEI 的灵感来自 Minecraft 的 JEI。打开原版物品栏时，它会在旁边显示一个查询面板，帮你查物品和液体的获取途径、制作配方与用途。原版制作系统保持不变。

### 功能

- 浏览游戏运行时的全部物品和液体，包括受支持模组添加的条目。
- 按名称搜索、按分类筛选，收藏的条目排在最前。
- 左键物品或液体查看获取途径和制作配方，右键查看用途。
- 获取途径和制作配方使用图标卡片，默认每页 2 行，可在设置中改为 1–4 行；液体显示来源、容器和液体的关系，特殊描述条件保留在「描述补充」。
- 点击配方里的材料或产物继续查询；悬停泛材料可查看符合条件的候选，数量较多时只显示一部分。
- 一键打开原版制作面板中的对应配方，或直接收藏这条配方。
- 可调整界面语言、面板位置、大小和每页卡片行数。
- 实体分类收录商人、生物和场景物件，也可在「全部」中搜索和收藏；点击可查看原文描述。
- 可选作弊功能：领取物品和液体、生成实体、一键复活。默认关闭，受游戏和服务器权限限制。

### 安装

- **Gale**：在 Casualties: Unknown 的模组列表中搜索 UEI 并安装，BepInEx 会自动一起安装。也可以把下载的 ZIP 直接导入 Gale。
- **手动**：先安装 BepInEx 5，再把 ZIP 中的 `BepInEx` 文件夹合并到游戏目录。
- 升级前请先关闭游戏，并确认只保留一份 UEI。

### 使用

1. 进入游戏，打开原版右键物品栏，UEI 面板会出现在旁边。
2. 用搜索框和分类箭头查找条目，点击星标收藏。没有可用图标的条目显示黑紫棋盘格。
3. 普通浏览时，左键物品或液体打开来源页，用上方按钮切换获取途径、制作配方和描述补充；右键打开用途页。实体左右键都显示原文描述，保留颜色、字号和图标，长内容可滚动。点击容器、材料或产物可以继续查。
4. 翻页：点击箭头，或在面板上滚动滚轮、按 PageUp / PageDown。
5. 点击搜索框旁的齿轮，可调整语言、位置、比例、每页卡片行数（1–4 行）和作弊开关。

开启作弊后，右键仍查看详情，左键改为：物品领取 1 个；液体领取装满该液体的临时瓶（默认 1000 mL，5 分钟后消失），背包放不下时瓶子留在脚边；实体进入定位，背包自动收起，移动鼠标选择落点，再次左键生成 1 个。右键或 Esc 取消定位，背包键取消并打开背包。

定位时显示半透明的静态 Sprite 预览，保留实际尺寸、原点、翻转和可见贴图层，不包含动画、线条等渲染方式；预览只是本地画面，确认前不会创建可交互实体。抓缠草这类没有可用预览的实体只显示文字提示，仍可生成。

### 兼容性与已知限制

- Together、CUCoreLib、RshLib、SexMod 都是可选适配，不安装也能正常使用。
- Together 联机：房主需开启 `sv_cheats`；客户端需要服务器授予的管理员命令权限，服务器执行时仍会检查 `sv_cheats`，所以能打开开关不代表请求一定成功。客户端的领取和生成都通过服务器命令提交，液体领取需要房主也安装同一版本的 UEI，模组物品需由房主生成。双端同步、存档与重连尚未完整实测。
- 获取途径读取当前游戏的实体掉落字段、实际掉落池、商人随机库存规则和液体容器内容，无需中文补丁或联网；描述标注保留为补充。首次读取分批进行，完成前来源可能继续补充。
- 随机来源注明抽取与概率条件。地形生成、脚本事件及全部模组来源尚未覆盖；读取失败会说明信息可能不完整，缺少信息不代表无法获得。
- 本包只包含 UEI，不含游戏文件、BepInEx 或其他模组。

### 链接与致谢

- 源码与发布：[GitHub](https://github.com/MAakber/Unknown-Enough-Items)
- 问题反馈：[GitHub Issues](https://github.com/MAakber/Unknown-Enough-Items/issues)
- 各版本的更新内容见 Changelog 页签。

作者：**Aakber（小叶子）**。感谢 **dfgger433** 的兼容性贡献。UEI 使用 MIT 许可证，许可证文件随包附带。

## English

Inspired by Minecraft's JEI, UEI shows a lookup panel beside the game's inventory, so you can check how items and liquids are crafted, what they are used for and, where available, where to find them. The game's own crafting system is left untouched.

### Features

- Browse every item and liquid loaded at runtime, including entries added by supported mods.
- Find merchants, creatures and world objects under Entities or All, using the same search and favorites; click one to read its original description.
- Search by name and filter by category; favorites are listed first.
- Left-click an item or liquid for its acquisition info and crafting recipes; right-click for its uses.
- Acquisition and crafting use icon cards, two rows per page by default and 1–4 rows in settings. Liquid cards show their source, container and liquid; special description conditions remain under Notes.
- Click an ingredient or result to look it up; hover a generic ingredient to see matching candidates (long lists show only some of them).
- Open the game's crafting panel at the current recipe, or pin that recipe.
- Change the UI language, panel position, scale and cards per page.
- Optional cheats: give yourself items or liquids, spawn entities, or revive. Off by default and subject to game and server permissions.

### Install

- **Gale**: search for UEI in the Casualties: Unknown mod list and install it; BepInEx is installed automatically. You can also import a downloaded ZIP into Gale.
- **Manual**: install BepInEx 5 first, then merge the ZIP's `BepInEx` folder into the game folder.
- Close the game before updating, and keep only one copy of UEI.

### Usage

1. In game, open the native right-click inventory; the UEI panel appears beside it.
2. Find entries with the search box and category arrows; click the star on an entry to favorite it. Entries without a usable icon show a black/magenta checkerboard.
3. During normal browsing, left-click an item or liquid for its Source page, then switch between Acquisition, Crafting recipes and Notes above the cards; right-click for its Uses page. Entities show their original description on either click, keeping colors, sizes and sprites, and long text scrolls. Click containers, ingredients or results to keep exploring.
4. To change pages, click the arrows, or use the mouse wheel or PageUp / PageDown over the panel.
5. Click the gear next to the search box to change the language, position, scale, cards per page (1–4 rows) and cheat setting.

With cheats on, right-click still opens details, and left-click depends on the entry: an item gives you one; a liquid gives you a full temporary bottle (1000 mL by default, disappears after five minutes), left at your feet if your inventory is full; an entity starts placement, closing the inventory so you can choose a spot with the mouse, and a second left-click spawns one there. Right-click or Esc cancels placement; the inventory key cancels and opens the inventory.

Placement shows a translucent static-sprite preview with the entity's actual size, origin, flipping and visible sprite layers, but without animation, lines or other renderers. The preview is only a local image; no interactive entity exists until you confirm. Entities with no usable preview, such as the Tentacle-plant, show a text hint instead and can still be spawned.

### Compatibility and known issues

- Support for Together, CUCoreLib, RshLib and SexMod is optional; UEI works without them.
- Together multiplayer: the host needs `sv_cheats` enabled. Clients need admin-command permission from the server, and the server still checks `sv_cheats` when it runs a request, so an enabled switch does not guarantee success. Clients give and spawn through server commands; liquid delivery needs the same UEI version on the host, and mod items must be spawned by the host. Synchronization between players, saving and reconnecting have not been fully tested.
- Acquisition info uses current building drops, actual loot pools, random trader-stock rules and filled-container contents. No Chinese patch or network connection is required; description annotations remain supplements. The first scan runs in batches and may add more sources as it finishes.
- Random sources include draw/probability conditions. Terrain generation, scripted events and all mod sources are not fully covered. Failed reads disclose incomplete coverage; missing information does not mean an entry is unobtainable.
- This package contains UEI only: no game files, BepInEx or other mods.

### Links and credits

- Source code and releases: [GitHub](https://github.com/MAakber/Unknown-Enough-Items)
- Bug reports: [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/MAakber/Unknown-Enough-Items/issues)
- See the Changelog tab for what's new in each version.

# What is this?

Milky is perceived by some to be the weakest character in the game. While Expie is a great all-rounder for getting through the game, and Dune's strengths easily outweigh their weaknesses, Milky's starting INT and gun controls barely make up for their narcolepsy and insistence on not eating meat. While I do really enjoy playing Milky, a buff would tip the scales in their favor.

So to make up for their shortcomings, this mod adds several new recipes for Milky to craft like bulk ammo, stims, and of course, grav-bags. Now Milky is probably absolutely insane and unbalanced lol

# Is there anything custom?

Yes, in fact! But not too much.

The mod features three custom firearms which are upgraded versions of existing weapons. The mod also features extended magazines to further curbstomp anything that comes your way.

Lastly, for Expie and Dune specifically, you might come across some white blueprints in your runs. These can "discover" the new milky exclusive recipes, though you'll still need the INT to craft them and there's no way to learn them from normal blueprints.

# Requirements

BepInEx and CCL are required to run the mod

Future versions of CCL past v1.1 might break some things; discretion advised with future versions.

Some mods that edit the guns function can also conflict, I haven't tested anything

RedTopTom for planting the initial idea in my head, and some additional pointers

Me for almost scope creeping this mod into oblivion before realizing it's probably time to jump ship lol

Name: RemoveTinnitus
Summary: It removes tinnitus and doesn't use AI. That's it
Description:
# What does this do?

Remove Tinnitus does exactly what the name says while additionally reducing the volume of sound cannon hits, gunshots, and explosions.
It has no config (right now), no other features and has no dependencies. You can use it if you want, but it likely wasn't made with you in mind, and the other mods around should be enough for your use.

# Why does this exist?

Most mods made for this game use AI, including most mods that modify sounds for accessibility reasons. AI is also known to be very bad for the environment.
While I do see it as a good force on occasion I do not approve of it's use right now due to it's environmental impact on the world, and so this mod was made with that purpose in mind.
You can see it as being petty, which is fair, but I don't care what you think. Like I said; this mod wasn't made with you in mind.

# Why not just use QOL?

QOL Unknown is a good mod and the creator is a great guy! But for my purposes it does a little too much, and it feels a bit too non-vanilla for my liking. I just need a mod that stops the tinnitus effect.
However for 99.9% of players (which this mod wasn't made for) I would greatly recommend it. QOL is not available on this website yet; I'll put it here when it is!

Name: SaveManager
Summary: SM - unlimited save slots for Casualties Unknown. Save anytime with F5, pick any slot from a native settings tab, sandbox & multiplayer aware.
Description:
# SM (Save Manager)

给 **Casualties Unknown** 加**无上限存档槽**的 BepInEx 5 插件。
Unlimited save slots for **Casualties Unknown** — a BepInEx 5 plugin.

[中文](#中文) · [English](#english) · [License](#license)

---

## 中文

### 简介

原版只有一个续关点 `save.sv`，而且**读档成功后就把文件删掉**。SM 把每次存档拍成独立快照：游戏里随时按 `F5` 存，设置菜单里多出一个「存档」分页可以挑任意一档读，档数没有上限，游戏外也能直接拖文件换档。界面全部用游戏原生 prefab 拼，和设置菜单其它页一个样。

### 功能

- **无上限存档槽**：每次存档一个独立文件夹，自动命名（`2026-11-22_1534_D1`）
- **游戏内随时存档**：`F5`，不用回主菜单
- **设置菜单第 6 个分页「存档」**：左侧操作栏 + 右侧可滚动存档列表，行/字体/边框/音效都是游戏原生的
- **ESC 暂停菜单的圆形存档按钮**：白线圆环 + 软盘图标，点一下直达存档分页，弹出动画与原生按钮一致
- **游戏内直接读档**：解除暂停 → 回主菜单 → 铺档 → 继续，回到该层开头
- **沙盒档 / 实机档双向隔离**：沙盒里只看得到沙盒档，反之亦然，跨模式读取会被拒绝
- **联机兼容**：把 [CasualtiesTogether](https://github.com/creaturefeaturelarry/casualties-together) 的 `mp_save\`（每个玩家的 `STEAM_<id>\save.sv`、`mp_rules.json`）整目录收进槽里
- **覆盖前自动留上一档**，可一键回滚
- **所有开关都能在游戏里改**（存档页 →「存档选项与设置 ▸」独立子页），改完立即写盘，下次启动保持
- **控制台命令**，方便脚本化

### 安装

需要 **BepInEx 5.4.23.x**（`netstandard2.1`）。

- **Thunderstore**：[**SuzuAy-SaveManager**](https://thunderstore.io/c/casualties-unknown/p/SuzuAy/SaveManager/)（社区 Casualties: Unknown）
- **Gale**：Gale 是 Thunderstore 客户端，在 Mods 页搜 `SaveManager` 即可（或直接装上面的包）
- **手动**：

```
<游戏目录>\BepInEx\plugins\SaveManager\SaveManager.dll
```

启动后 `BepInEx\LogOutput.log` 里应能看到 `设置页已注册「存档」分页`。

### 使用

| 键 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| `F5` | 存档到新槽（自动命名） |
| `F8` | 打开设置 →「存档」分页（游戏内会先自动暂停） |
| `F9` | 读最近一档（按当前模式取） |

也可以走原生路径：`Esc` 暂停 → 设置 → 点「存档」。

存档页布局：

```
┌──────────────┬──────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ ＋ 新建存档   │ 已选：2026-11-22_1534_D1                 │
│ 读取最近一档  │ ┌ 新名字 ──────────────────────────────┐ │
│ 打开文件夹    │ └──────────────────────────────────────┘ │
│ 读取此档      │ 共 4 档（无上限，按时间倒序）             │
│ 回滚上一档    │ ▶ 2026-11-22_1621_D1  D1 · 0m28s · 4件 · 联机 │
│ 删除此档      │   2026-11-22_1610_D1  D1 · 1m22s · 0件 · 沙盒 │
│ 存档设置 ▸    │   …（右侧列表可滚轮/拖拽滚动）            │
└──────────────┴──────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

控制台命令：

```
cssave [名字]      存一个新槽（不写名字=自动命名）
cslots             列出所有槽
csload <槽名>      读这个槽（回主菜单流程）
csslots            打开设置里的「存档」分页
csdir              打开存档目录
csdel <槽名>       删除
csrename <旧> <新>  改名
csrollback <槽名>   回滚到该槽的 backup/
csexport <槽名>     把槽铺成游戏当前的 save.sv
```

### 存档放在哪

```
%USERPROFILE%\AppData\LocalLow\Orsoniks\CasualtiesUnknown\SaveSlots\
  <槽名>\
    meta.json     元数据（时间/层数/存活/角色/件数/模式/沙盒/作弊/玩家）
    save.sv       单人存档（原版格式，gzip + JSON）
    mp\           联机存档（存在时才有）
    backup\       覆盖同名槽之前的上一档
```

不进游戏换档：

1. 关掉游戏
2. `SaveSlots\<槽名>\save.sv` 覆盖到 `...\Orsoniks\CasualtiesUnknown\save.sv`
3. 联机档：`SaveSlots\<槽名>\mp\` 整个覆盖到 `...\CasualtiesUnknown\mp_save\`
4. 开游戏 → 主菜单点「继续」

### 配置

`BepInEx\config\suzuay.savemanager.cfg`（也能在游戏「存档设置」子页改，重启后保持）

| 键 | 默认 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `ExperimentalInGameLoad` | `true` | 游戏内直接读档 |
| `AutoSave.Enabled` / `Minutes` | `false` / `5` | 定时自动存档 |
| `MarkCheatedSave` | `false` | 存档标记 cheated（成就关闭到重启） |
| `SandboxNoCheatMark` | `true` | 沙盒里不标作弊 |
| `AllowInMultiplayer` | `true` | 联机时允许存读档 |
| `KeepLastBackup` | `true` | 覆盖同名槽前保留上一档 |
| `BypassTutorialGate` | `true` | 没做完基础教程也能读档 |
| `SlotRootOverride` | 空 | 自定义存档根目录 |
| `QuickSave` / `QuickLoad` / `Panel` | `F5` / `F9` / `F8` | 键位 |

### 已知限制

1. **读档回到当前层的开头**：原版 `save.sv` 只存身体/物品/世界数值，不含地图布局与玩家坐标，地图每层随机重新生成（原版 `saveandquit` 同样如此）
2. **深度 ≥ 9（WHERE WE MUST REACH 及之后）**：原版不许存档，本插件绕过控制台检查直接调 `SaveGame()`，但读回来是否正常未验证，别在终点层存
3. **联机**：只负责整目录搬运 `mp_save\`，多人局细节取决于 CasualtiesTogether 本身
4. **成就**：`MarkCheatedSave` 默认关；打开后按原版语义「成就关闭到重启」

### 兼容性

| 项 | 版本 |
|---|---|
| 游戏 | Casualties Unknown（Unity **2022.3.62f3**，Mono） |
| BepInEx | 5.4.23.x（`netstandard2.1`） |
| HarmonyX | 随 BepInEx 一起（`0Harmony.dll`） |
| 联机模组 | CasualtiesTogether（`mp_save\` 格式） |

### 构建

```powershell
git clone https://github.com/SuzuAy/SaveManager
cd SaveManager
Copy-Item local.props.example local.props   # 填自己的游戏路径
dotnet build SaveManager.csproj -c Release
```

`local.props` 填两个路径：`GameRoot`（游戏根目录，含 `CasualtiesUnknown_Data\Managed`）、`GaleProfileBepInEx`（BepInEx 目录，含 `core\` 与 `plugins\`）。编完自动把 DLL 拷到 `plugins\SaveManager\`。

也可以直接命令行覆盖：

```powershell
dotnet build -c Release -p:GameRoot="D:\Games\Casualties Unknown" -p:GaleProfileBepInEx="D:\Games\Casualties Unknown\BepInEx"
```

---

## English

### What it is

Vanilla *Casualties Unknown* keeps a single resume point (`save.sv`) and **deletes it once you load it**. SM snapshots every save into its own folder: press `F5` anytime, open the new **Save** tab in the settings menu to load any slot — unlimited slots — and you can swap files on disk while the game is closed. The UI is built from the game's own prefabs, so it matches the rest of the settings menu.

### Features

- **Unlimited slots**, auto-named (`2026-11-22_1534_D1`)
- **Save anytime in-game** with `F5`
- **Native "Save" tab** (6th settings page): left action column + scrollable slot list
- **In-game load**: unpause → main menu → restore files → continue (back to the start of the current layer)
- **Sandbox / normal saves are isolated** from each other; cross-loading is refused
- **Multiplayer aware**: captures the whole `mp_save\` folder used by [CasualtiesTogether](https://github.com/creaturefeaturelarry/casualties-together) (per-player `STEAM_<id>\save.sv`, `mp_rules.json`)
- **Keeps the previous version** of a slot before overwriting; one-click rollback
- **All options editable in-game** (Save → "Save options ▸" sub-page) and persisted to the config
- **Console commands** for scripting

### Install

Requires **BepInEx 5.4.23.x** (`netstandard2.1`).

- **Thunderstore**: [**SuzuAy-SaveManager**](https://thunderstore.io/c/casualties-unknown/p/SuzuAy/SaveManager/) (community Casualties: Unknown)
- **Gale**: Gale *is* a Thunderstore client — search `SaveManager` on the Mods page
- **Manual**: drop the DLL at `<GameDir>\BepInEx\plugins\SaveManager\SaveManager.dll`

### Keys

`F5` save · `F8` open the Save tab · `F9` load the most recent slot of the current mode

```
cssave [name]   cslots   csload <slot>   csslots   csdir
csdel <slot>    csrename <old> <new>    csrollback <slot>    csexport <slot>
```

### Save location

```
%USERPROFILE%\AppData\LocalLow\Orsoniks\CasualtiesUnknown\SaveSlots\<slot>\
    meta.json   save.sv   mp\   backup\
```

To swap a slot outside the game: copy `<slot>\save.sv` over `...\CasualtiesUnknown\save.sv` (and `<slot>\mp\` over `...\CasualtiesUnknown\mp_save\` for multiplayer saves), then launch the game and press Continue.

### Known limitations

1. Loading returns you to the **beginning of the current layer** — vanilla saves contain no map layout or player position
2. Depth ≥ 9 layers cannot be saved in vanilla; this mod bypasses that check but loading such a save is untested
3. Multiplayer handling is limited to copying `mp_save\`; the rest is up to CasualtiesTogether
4. `MarkCheatedSave` is off by default; enabling it disables achievements until restart

Description:
#### **PREPARE YOURSELF, LITTLE FRIEND!**

##### **What is it?**

**Addon for CU multiplayer mod (Casualties: Together). After spawning, each player gets a loadout menu once per campaign. They pick items within a budget, and the game delivers them in a temporary supply crate.**

##### **How to install?**

Install with a mod manager, or unpack the CasPrepared folder into /bepinex/plugins.

The host and every player need the same CasPrepared version. A player with another version sees the host as having no mod.

##### **Main features**

* Loadout menu. Searchable item catalog with categories, a selection list, the budget and the loadout cost. The Spawn button is blocked when the cost exceeds the budget.
* Presets. Save loadouts under your own names and load them in one click. Each preset shows its cost at the current host's prices.
* Prices. Each item costs its trader price times a host-adjustable multiplier (default 1.0).
* Item rules. The host can set custom prices, hide items and add items that traders do not sell. Players get the rules automatically.
* Host-authoritative. Every purchase is a request to the host over Casualties: Together. The host validates it and spawns the items at the player's position.
* Supply crate. Items arrive in a temporary crate that cannot be carried or worn. It decays after 5 minutes by default, and its contents drop on the floor.
* Once per campaign. The host records players by SteamID, and the records are saved with the campaign.
* Spawn window. The menu closes after a time limit (can be turned off) or when the player moves too far from the spawn point.
* Achievements stay enabled.
* Server settings toggle. A checkbox in Together's Server settings turns the mod on or off.

##### **Console commands**

All commands go through one console command: casprep \[command] \[value]. Tab completes command names and item ids. casprep help lists everything.

|Command|Description|
|-|-|
|casprep menu|Open or close the loadout menu (default key F6)|
|casprep enable \[on/off]|Turn the mod on or off for sessions you host|
|casprep budget \[n]|Loadout budget per player (default 100)|
|casprep mult \[x]|Price multiplier (default 1.0)|
|casprep window \[sec/off]|Seconds the menu stays available after spawn; 0 or off removes the limit (default 300)|
|casprep radius \[tiles]|Maximum distance from spawn before the menu closes (default 100)|
|casprep cratetime \[sec]|Supply crate lifetime (default 300)|
|casprep status|Show settings and list players with their loadout state|
|casprep reset \[player/all]|Let a player pick a loadout again|
|casprep cheats|Show whether cheat rules allow casprep giveloadout|
|casprep giveloadout \[player]|Open the menu again; needs sv\_cheats (and AllowClientCheatCommands for clients)|
|casprep setprice \[item] \[price]|Custom base price per unit, before the multiplier|
|casprep resetprice \[item/all]|Back to the trader price|
|casprep ban \[item]|Hide an item from the list|
|casprep unban \[item/all]|Show a hidden item again|
|casprep additem \[item] \[price]|Add an item that traders do not sell|
|casprep removeitem \[item]|Remove an added item|
|casprep items|List custom prices, hidden and added items|

Settings are locked during a running campaign unless sv\_cheats is on.

##### **Requirements**

BepInEx

CUCoreLib

Casualties: Together

Orsoniks For such awesome game;

CU:Together and CUCoreLib devs For letting us playing with friends.
